materials.name: FR4 Standard
materials.notes: Default values the fabricator uses for this class of material (not a laminate maker's sheet); the real material depends on availability (for example Isola Duraver, Shengyi S1141, KingBoard 6160, Panasonic R-1766M). Tg at least 135 C; CTE-z 60 ppm/C (the sheet does not say below or above Tg); tracking resistance 175-249 (Isola recommends 200) V; CTI PLC 3; peel strength 1.1-1.6 N/mm; standard IPC-4101.

materials.name: FR4 High-Tg
materials.notes: Default values the fabricator uses for this class of material (not a laminate maker's sheet); the real material depends on availability (for example Isola IS410, Shengyi S1000-2, Iteq IT180-A, Panasonic R-1755V). Tg at least 170 C; CTE-z 45 ppm/C (the sheet does not say below or above Tg); tracking resistance 175-249 (Isola recommends 200) V; CTI PLC 3; peel strength 1.2 N/mm; standard IPC-4101.

materials.name: FR4 Halogen-free
materials.notes: Default values the fabricator uses for this class of material (not a laminate maker's sheet); the real material depends on availability (for example Isola Duraver 156, Shengyi S1155, KingBoard 6162, Panasonic R-1566V). Tg at least 140 C; CTE-z 45 ppm/C (the sheet does not say below or above Tg); tracking resistance 175-249 (Isola recommends 200) V; CTI PLC 3; peel strength 1.4 N/mm; standard IPC-4101.

materials.name: FR4 Track resistant
materials.notes: Default values the fabricator uses for this class of material (not a laminate maker's sheet); the real material depends on availability (for example Isola Duraver KF, Shengyi S1600). Tg at least 135 C; CTE-z 50 ppm/C (the sheet does not say below or above Tg); tracking resistance 400-599 (PLC 0 of 600 V or more on request) V; CTI PLC 1; peel strength 1.6 N/mm; standard IPC-4101.

materials.name: Polyimide
materials.notes: Default values the fabricator uses for this class of material (not a laminate maker's sheet); the real material depends on availability (for example DuPont Pyralux, Shengyi SF302, Panasonic R-F775; recommended operating temperature 105 C (210 C on request, Arlon)). Tg at least 230 C; CTE-z 20 ppm/C (the sheet does not say below or above Tg); tracking resistance none given V; CTI none given; peel strength 1.6 N/mm; standard IPC-4204.
